# Payment Gateway Verification

## When to use
Use when the task requires verify all six stages in a legitimate payment route from buyer to actual spendable funds in Iraq.

## Procedure
Read references/payment-route.md. Verify buyer payment, platform receipt, withdrawable balance, payout provider, accessible Iraqi account, usable funds. Each stage status must be VERIFIED/UNVERIFIED/BLOCKED with current official evidence and currency/fees. Unverified route is a hard hold. Do not suggest KYC circumvention.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
